pointers.sentence: With `settings.USE_I18N` false it returns the entries as a list, with no resolver around them (`django/conf/urls/i18n.py:i18n_patterns`).
`LocalePrefixPattern.match` succeeds when the path begins with exactly that (`django/urls/resolvers.py:LocalePrefixPattern.language_prefix`, `django/urls/resolvers.py:LocalePrefixPattern.match`).

`LocaleMiddleware` is, in its `process_request`, which runs before the handler resolves anything ([Internationalization and time zones](../i18n.md)) (`django/middleware/locale.py:LocaleMiddleware.process_request`).

`is_language_prefix_patterns_used` goes through the entries of the root resolver's list, and no deeper, and returns two answers: whether one of them has a `LocalePrefixPattern` for its matcher, and whether that matcher gives the default language a prefix (`django/conf/urls/i18n.py:is_language_prefix_patterns_used`).

The function looks nowhere but in that one list, and `include` refuses a URLconf that would put a language prefix lower down: it looks through the list of the URLconf it is given and raises `ImproperlyConfigured` if one of the entries has a `LocalePrefixPattern` (`django/urls/conf.py:include`).
It asks the resolver through `is_valid_path`, as `CommonMiddleware` does for a missing slash (`django/middleware/locale.py:LocaleMiddleware.process_response`).

For anything else it asks the route for its text, expands that into an expression, compiles it, and keeps the result in a dictionary on the matcher under the active language's code; a read under another language does all of that again (`django/urls/resolvers.py:LocaleRegexRouteDescriptor`).
`RegexPattern` has a descriptor of the same design (`django/urls/resolvers.py:LocaleRegexDescriptor`).

`URLResolver._populate` files what it builds under the language that is active as it runs, and each of the three properties that read them calls it again when the active language has no entry yet (`django/urls/resolvers.py:URLResolver._populate`, `django/urls/resolvers.py:URLResolver.reverse_dict`).

The scheme, host, query string and fragment of the URL it was given are put back around the new path (`django/urls/base.py:translate_url`).
